The proposed solution relies on a known classification of the relation type ($\text{rt}(X)$) for sets of points $X$ in generic position in the projective plane $\mathbb{P}^2_k$.

According to results in algebraic geometry concerning the ideals of points in $\mathbb{P}^2_k$:
1. If $X$ consists of $n \le 8$ points in generic position, the relation type $\text{rt}(X) = 1$.
2. If $X$ consists of $n \ge 9$ points in generic position, the relation type $\text{rt}(X) = 2$.

The problem specifies $n=11$ points. Since $11 \ge 9$, the classification dictates that $\text{rt}(X) = 2$.

The proposed solution correctly applies this classification.
